period.description: Duration of the measurement period (ISO-8601 duration, e.g., PT5M). Either 'period' or 'period_start' required.
period.title: Period

period_end.description: End of the measurement period (ISO-8601 with timezone, exclusive).
period_end.title: Period End

period_start.description: Start of the measurement period (ISO-8601 with timezone, inclusive). Alternative to 'period'.
period_start.title: Period Start

period_start.description: Start of the availability interval in ISO 8601 format.
period_start.title: Period Start

period_end.description: End of the availability interval in ISO 8601 format.
period_end.title: Period End

availability.description: Availability percentage for the interval, from 0 to 100.
availability.title: Availability

latitude.description: The latitude of the resource. Must be a decimal number between -90 and 90.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude of the resource. Must be a decimal number between -180 and 180.
longitude.title: Longitude

capacity.description: Total inverter (nameplate) capacity in MW. This is the highest potential output of the system before any Site Export Limit is applied. It is used to model the conversion of DC power to AC by your inverters.
capacity.title: Capacity

capacity_dc.description: Total module capacity in MW. Usually slightly higher than the AC capacity. It is used to model the generation of DC power by your modules.
capacity_dc.title: Capacity Dc

tracking_type.description: The type of sun-tracking or geometry configuration of your site's modules. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracking_type.title: Tracking Type

install_date.description: The date when your site was installed. It is used to derate your module (DC) production gradually with age, at a rate dependent on your Module Type.
install_date.title: Install Date

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

azimuth.description: The angle from true north the modules are facing. North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward facing is negative values. Westward facing is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
azimuth.title: Azimuth

tilt.description: The off-horizontal tilt angle of modules for a fixed-tilt site.
tilt.title: Tilt

grid_export_limit.description: Optional maximum power export allowed by the site's grid connection, in MW. Omit this field when no limit is configured. Values >= 0  configure a limit. Value of -1 is treated as no configured limit. Only impacts your AC power if the grid export limit is set lower than the AC capacity. A configured limit will be in effect the next time predictions are updated.
grid_export_limit.title: Grid Export Limit

module_type.description: The type of material or technology used in your site's PV modules. It is used to estimate your module temperature derating coefficient (unless you specify your own coefficient), and used to estimate your module age derating.
module_type.title: Module Type

ground_coverage_ratio.description: The proportion of the site's ground area covered by modules. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules. Must be at least 0.01 and at most 1.
ground_coverage_ratio.title: Ground Coverage Ratio

derating_temp_module.description: The factor by which your site’s module (DC) production varies with differences in temperature from standard operating conditions ( 25 oC ). Can be found on module spec sheets and its often referred as: temperature coefficient of power or pmp.
derating_temp_module.title: Derating Temp Module

derating_age_system.description: The factor by which the whole system will be derated per year since Install Date. It is used to calculate time dependent system loss.
derating_age_system.title: Derating Age System

derating_other_system.description: The total system losses as a fraction of the total energy output. This excludes shading, soiling, snow, inverter, temperature and age. Includes losses such as wiring.
derating_other_system.title: Derating Other System

inverter_peak_efficiency.description: The peak efficiency value in your inverter efficiency curve. It is used to scale the conversion efficiency of DC to AC, as a function of the inverter load. Must be at least 0.01 and at most 1.
inverter_peak_efficiency.title: Inverter Peak Efficiency

tracker_axis_azimuth.description: The off north-south azimuth angle for a horizontal single axis tracking site. Most commonly this will be close to zero.  North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward facing is negative values. Westward facing is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_axis_azimuth.title: Tracker Axis Azimuth

tracker_max_rotation_angle.description: The maximum off-horizontal angle for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_max_rotation_angle.title: Tracker Max Rotation Angle

tracker_back_tracking.description: Whether the trackers backtrack at low solar elevation angles, for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_back_tracking.title: Tracker Back Tracking

tracker_smart_tracking.description: Whether the trackers move to horizontal during cloudy periods with zero DNI, for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_smart_tracking.title: Tracker Smart Tracking

terrain_slope.description: The average terrain slope in degrees from horizontal of your site. A site with no terrain slope has a value of zero.
terrain_slope.title: Terrain Slope

terrain_azimuth.description: The average terrain slope downhill direction. North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward is negative values. Westward is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
terrain_azimuth.title: Terrain Azimuth

dust_soiling_average.description: The average proportion of module production lost due to dust soiling. If supplied, must contain exactly 12 monthly values in January-to-December order, each between 0 and 1. The values should reflect the impact of cleaning activity at your site. It is used to calculate the module (DC) production.
dust_soiling_average.title: Dust Soiling Average

bifacial_system.description: Bifacial systems have modules that produce solar power not only from the front, but also the rear side of the panel. Used to create additional parameters that will allow us to model your production more accurately.
bifacial_system.title: Bifacial System

site_ground_albedo.description: The proportion of the incident downward irradiance reflected by the ground surface in the area underneath the PV modules. Used to calculate local ground-reflected irradiance. Particularly important for bifacial systems.
site_ground_albedo.title: Site Ground Albedo

bifaciality_factor.description: For bifacial modules, the module rear efficiency as a proportion of the front efficiency subject to the same irradiance. Used to calculate the module rear production for bifacial systems.
bifaciality_factor.title: Bifaciality Factor

pvrow_height.description: The height of the module rows, in metres, measured from the ground to the row center or axis. Used to calculate the module rear incident irradiance and production for bifacial systems.
pvrow_height.title: Pvrow Height

pvrow_width.description: The width of the module rows, in metres. This is the cross-section width of the entire PV row. Used to calculate the module rear incident irradiance and production for bifacial systems.
pvrow_width.title: Pvrow Width

clearsky_zenith_coefficients.description: Coefficients used to model clear-sky solar zenith irradiance for the resource.
clearsky_zenith_coefficients.title: Clearsky Zenith Coefficients

cloudy_zenith_coefficients.description: Coefficients used to model cloudy-sky solar zenith irradiance for the resource.
cloudy_zenith_coefficients.title: Cloudy Zenith Coefficients

forecast_production_status.description: Premium PV only. The forecast production status for this resource. Allowed values: PENDING, ACTIVE.
forecast_production_status.title: Forecast Production Status

use_live_measurements.description: Premium PV only. Indicates whether live measurement blending is enabled for downstream nowcasts.
use_live_measurements.title: Use Live Measurements

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the Premium PV Power resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

period_start.description: Start of the curtailment interval in ISO 8601 format.
period_start.title: Period Start

period_end.description: End of the curtailment interval in ISO 8601 format.
period_end.title: Period End

curtailment.description: Curtailment power cap for the interval in MW.
curtailment.title: Curtailment

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the Premium PV Power resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

period_start.description: Start of the delete window (ISO 8601). Must be on a 5-minute boundary.
period_start.title: Period Start

period_end.description: End of the delete window (ISO 8601). Must be on a 5-minute boundary.
period_end.title: Period End

schedule_type.description: Comma-separated list of schedule types to delete: availability, curtailment
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

hours.description: The number of hours to return in the response.
hours.title: Hours

output_parameters.description: The output parameters to include in the response.
output_parameters.title: Output Parameters

resource_id.description: The resource id of the resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

period.description: Length of the averaging period in ISO 8601 duration format. Default is PT30M.
period.title: Period

apply_availability.description: Percentage of the site’s total AC (inverter) capacity that is currently generating or expected to be generating during the forecast request period. E.g. if you specify a 50% availability, your returned power will be half of what it otherwise would be.
apply_availability.title: Apply Availability

apply_constraint.description: Constraint on site’s total AC production, applied as a cap in the same way as the metadata parameter Site Export Limit. This will constrain all Solcast power values to be no higher than the apply_constraint value you specify. If you need an unconstrained forecast, you should not use this parameter.
apply_constraint.title: Apply Constraint

apply_dust_soiling.description: A user-override for dust_soiling_average. If you specify this parameter in your API call, we will replace the site's annual or monthly average dust soiling values with the value you specify in your API call.E.g. if you specify a 0.7 dust soiling, your returned power will be reduced by 70%.
apply_dust_soiling.title: Apply Dust Soiling

apply_snow_soiling.description: A user-override for Solcast’s dynamic snow soiling, which is based on global snow cover and weather forecast data, and changes from hour to hour. If you specify this parameter in your API call (e.g. if snow clearing has just been performed), we will replace the Solcast dynamic hour to hour value with the single value you specify. E.g. if you specify a 0.7 snow soiling, your returned power will be reduced by 70%.
apply_snow_soiling.title: Apply Snow Soiling

apply_tracker_inactive.description: Indicating if trackers are inactive. If True, panels are assumed all facing up (i.e. zero rotation). Only has effect if your site has a tracking_type that is not “fixed”.
apply_tracker_inactive.title: Apply Tracker Inactive

terrain_shading.description: If true, irradiance parameters are modified based on the surrounding terrain from a 90m-horizontal-resolution digital elevation model. The direct component of irradiance is set to zero when the beam from the sun is blocked by the terrain. The diffuse component of irradiance is reduced throughout the day if the sky view at the location is significantly reduced by the surrounding terrain. Global irradiance incorporates both effects.
terrain_shading.title: Terrain Shading

If you don't specify tilt, we use a default tilt angle based on the latitude you specify in your request. Must be between 0 and 90.

azimuth.description: The azimuth is defined as the angle (degrees) from true north that the PV system is facing. An azimuth of 0 means the system is facing true north. Positive values are anticlockwise, so azimuth is -90 for an east-facing system and 135 for a southwest-facing system. If you don't specify an azimuth, we use a default value of 0 (north facing) in the southern hemisphere and 180 (south-facing) in the northern hemisphere.

loss_factor.description: Default is 0.90 A factor to reduce your output forecast from the full capacity based on characteristics of the PV array or inverter. This is effectively the non-temperature loss effects on the nameplate rating of the PV system, including inefficiency and soiling. For a 1kW PV system anything that reduces 1000W/m2 solar radiation from producing 1000W of power output (assuming temperature is 25C). Valid values are between 0 and 1 (i.e. 0.6 equals 60%). If you specify 0.6 your returned power will be a maximum of 60% of AC capacity.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location you request data for. Must be a decimal number between -180 and 180.

hours.description: The number of hours to return in the response.
hours.title: Hours

period.description: Length of the averaging period in ISO 8601 duration format. Default is PT30M.
period.title: Period

latitude.description: The latitude of the location you request data for. Must be a decimal number between -90 and 90.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude of the location you request data for. Must be a decimal number between -180 and 180.
longitude.title: Longitude

capacity.description: The capacity of the inverter (AC) or the modules (DC), whichever is greater, in kilowatts (kW).
capacity.title: Capacity

tilt.description: The angle (degrees) that the PV system is tilted off the horizontal. A tilt of 0 means the system faces directly upwards, and 90 means the system is vertical and facing the horizon. If you don't specify tilt, we use a default tilt angle based on the latitude you specify in your request. Must be between 0 and 90.
tilt.title: Tilt

azimuth.description: The azimuth is defined as the angle (degrees) from true north that the PV system is facing. An azimuth of 0 means the system is facing true north. Positive values are anticlockwise, so azimuth is -90 for an east-facing system and 135 for a southwest-facing system. If you don't specify an azimuth, we use a default value of 0 (north facing) in the southern hemisphere and 180 (south-facing) in the northern hemisphere.
azimuth.title: Azimuth

install_date.description: The date (yyyy-MM-dd) of installation of the PV system. We use this to estimate your loss_factor based on the ageing of your system. If you provide us with a loss_factor directly, we will ignore this date.
install_date.title: Install Date

loss_factor.description: Default is 0.90 A factor to reduce your output forecast from the full capacity based on characteristics of the PV array or inverter. This is effectively the non-temperature loss effects on the nameplate rating of the PV system, including inefficiency and soiling. For a 1kW PV system anything that reduces 1000W/m2 solar radiation from producing 1000W of power output (assuming temperature is 25C). Valid values are between 0 and 1 (i.e. 0.6 equals 60%). If you specify 0.6 your returned power will be a maximum of 60% of AC capacity.
loss_factor.title: Loss Factor

output_parameters.description: The output parameters to include in the response.
output_parameters.title: Output Parameters

terrain_shading.description: If true, irradiance parameters are modified based on the surrounding terrain from a 90m-horizontal-resolution digital elevation model. The direct component of irradiance is set to zero when the beam from the sun is blocked by the terrain. The diffuse component of irradiance is reduced throughout the day if the sky view at the location is significantly reduced by the surrounding terrain. Global irradiance incorporates both effects.
terrain_shading.title: Terrain Shading

apply_snow_soiling.description: A user-override for Solcast’s dynamic snow soiling, which is based on global snow cover and weather forecast data, and changes from hour to hour. If you specify this parameter in your API call (e.g. if snow clearing has just been performed), we will replace the Solcast dynamic hour to hour value with the single value you specify. E.g. if you specify a 0.7 snow soiling, your returned power will be reduced by 70%.
apply_snow_soiling.title: Apply Snow Soiling

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

latitude.description: The latitude of the resource. Must be a decimal number between -90 and 90.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude of the resource. Must be a decimal number between -180 and 180.
longitude.title: Longitude

capacity.description: Total inverter (nameplate) capacity in MW. This is the highest potential output of the system before any Site Export Limit is applied. It is used to model the conversion of DC power to AC by your inverters.
capacity.title: Capacity

capacity_dc.description: Total module capacity in MW. Usually slightly higher than the AC capacity. It is used to model the generation of DC power by your modules.
capacity_dc.title: Capacity Dc

azimuth.description: The angle from true north the modules are facing. North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward facing is negative values. Westward facing is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
azimuth.title: Azimuth

tilt.description: The off-horizontal tilt angle of modules for a fixed-tilt site.
tilt.title: Tilt

tracking_type.description: The type of sun-tracking or geometry configuration of your site's modules. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracking_type.title: Tracking Type

install_date.description: The date when your site was installed. It is used to derate your module (DC) production gradually with age, at a rate dependent on your Module Type.
install_date.title: Install Date

grid_export_limit.description: Optional maximum power export allowed by the site's grid connection, in MW. Omit this field when no limit is configured. Values >= 0  configure a limit. Value of -1 is treated as no configured limit. Only impacts your AC power if the grid export limit is set lower than the AC capacity. A configured limit will be in effect the next time predictions are updated.
grid_export_limit.title: Grid Export Limit

module_type.description: The type of material or technology used in your site's PV modules. It is used to estimate your module temperature derating coefficient (unless you specify your own coefficient), and used to estimate your module age derating.
module_type.title: Module Type

ground_coverage_ratio.description: The proportion of the site's ground area covered by modules. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules. Must be at least 0.01 and at most 1.
ground_coverage_ratio.title: Ground Coverage Ratio

derating_temp_module.description: The factor by which your site’s module (DC) production varies with differences in temperature from standard operating conditions ( 25 oC ). Can be found on module spec sheets and its often referred as: temperature coefficient of power or pmp.
derating_temp_module.title: Derating Temp Module

derating_age_system.description: The factor by which the whole system will be derated per year since Install Date. It is used to calculate time dependent system loss.
derating_age_system.title: Derating Age System

derating_other_system.description: The total system losses as a fraction of the total energy output. This excludes shading, soiling, snow, inverter, temperature and age. Includes losses such as wiring.
derating_other_system.title: Derating Other System

inverter_peak_efficiency.description: The peak efficiency value in your inverter efficiency curve. It is used to scale the conversion efficiency of DC to AC, as a function of the inverter load. Must be at least 0.01 and at most 1.
inverter_peak_efficiency.title: Inverter Peak Efficiency

tracker_axis_azimuth.description: The off north-south azimuth angle for a horizontal single axis tracking site. Most commonly this will be close to zero.  North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward facing is negative values. Westward facing is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_axis_azimuth.title: Tracker Axis Azimuth

tracker_max_rotation_angle.description: The maximum off-horizontal angle for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_max_rotation_angle.title: Tracker Max Rotation Angle

tracker_back_tracking.description: Whether the trackers backtrack at low solar elevation angles, for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_back_tracking.title: Tracker Back Tracking

tracker_smart_tracking.description: Whether the trackers move to horizontal during cloudy periods with zero DNI, for a horizontal single axis tracking site. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
tracker_smart_tracking.title: Tracker Smart Tracking

terrain_slope.description: The average terrain slope in degrees from horizontal of your site. A site with no terrain slope has a value of zero.
terrain_slope.title: Terrain Slope

terrain_azimuth.description: The average terrain slope downhill direction. North is 0, South is ±180, Eastward is negative values. Westward is positive values. For example, -90 is due east. It is used to calculate the incident irradiance for your modules.
terrain_azimuth.title: Terrain Azimuth

dust_soiling_average.description: The average proportion of module production lost due to dust soiling. If supplied, must contain exactly 12 monthly values in January-to-December order, each between 0 and 1. The values should reflect the impact of cleaning activity at your site. It is used to calculate the module (DC) production.
dust_soiling_average.title: Dust Soiling Average

bifacial_system.description: Bifacial systems have modules that produce solar power not only from the front, but also the rear side of the panel. Used to create additional parameters that will allow us to model your production more accurately.
bifacial_system.title: Bifacial System

site_ground_albedo.description: The proportion of the incident downward irradiance reflected by the ground surface in the area underneath the PV modules. Used to calculate local ground-reflected irradiance. Particularly important for bifacial systems.
site_ground_albedo.title: Site Ground Albedo

bifaciality_factor.description: For bifacial modules, the module rear efficiency as a proportion of the front efficiency subject to the same irradiance. Used to calculate the module rear production for bifacial systems.
bifaciality_factor.title: Bifaciality Factor

pvrow_height.description: The height of the module rows, in metres, measured from the ground to the row center or axis. Used to calculate the module rear incident irradiance and production for bifacial systems.
pvrow_height.title: Pvrow Height

pvrow_width.description: The width of the module rows, in metres. This is the cross-section width of the entire PV row. Used to calculate the module rear incident irradiance and production for bifacial systems.
pvrow_width.title: Pvrow Width

clearsky_zenith_coefficients.description: Coefficients used to model clear-sky solar zenith irradiance for the resource.
clearsky_zenith_coefficients.title: Clearsky Zenith Coefficients

cloudy_zenith_coefficients.description: Coefficients used to model cloudy-sky solar zenith irradiance for the resource.
cloudy_zenith_coefficients.title: Cloudy Zenith Coefficients

forecast_production_status.description: Premium PV only. The forecast production status for this resource. Allowed values: PENDING, ACTIVE.
forecast_production_status.title: Forecast Production Status

use_live_measurements.description: Premium PV only. Indicates whether live measurement blending is enabled for downstream nowcasts.
use_live_measurements.title: Use Live Measurements
